body:
Adds `research/verifier-cascades`: information cascades among sequential verifiers. Exact wrong-cascade probability `(1-a)²/(a²+(1-a)²)`, expected cascade time, accuracy ceiling versus an independent majority, and the value of a sealed first batch. Recursion is checked against Bayesian agents simulated without the walk assumption. 9 stdlib-only tests, white paper, README and portfolio page entries.
